item.name: Assets & Inventory
item.description: The 20 shipped Assets and inventory routes for item/store master data, immutable stock movements, projected balances, and explicit goods-receipt allocation. Only allocation source listing and allocation creation depend on Procurement; reversal and every other Assets operation remain Assets-only, with no Finance or HR dependency. All quantities are exact scaled integers. Stock commands use the required JSON `idempotency_key` field, not an `Idempotency-Key` HTTP header; keep the variable unchanged only when retrying the same command.
